name: Samba Shares
description: Create and manage SMB shares for Windows, macOS and Linux clients: pick a folder, set who may read or write, and see the Samba service state. Needs the Samba host package — EthOS probes for it and tells you the exact install command instead of showing a dead toggle. Share definitions are written by EthOS itself (the only process with the narrow sudoers rule for smb.conf), so this package ships the desktop app only.
author: SyncHot
changelog:
1.1.0: declares the Samba host requirement. If smbd/testparm are missing the app now shows a banner with the exact install command and disables "+ Add Share" instead of failing with a raw error.
1.0.0: first release. The Samba Shares desktop app moves out of the core install; share configuration and the Samba service keep living in EthOS.
